methodology.bottleneck_probability: Share of Monte Carlo draws in which a constraint is the stage minimum; exact ties split probability equally.
methodology.constraint_reconciliation: For each draw and stage, output is the minimum system-equivalent capacity of all constraints required up to that stage.
methodology.customer_allocation: Shipped systems are allocated by sampled share, capped by sampled demand, with residual supply redistributed proportionally.
methodology.distribution: Independent triangular draws unless estimates share a correlation_group; reported ranges are not assumed normal.
methodology.opportunity_ranking: Research-priority score equals absolute bottom-up revenue revision times confidence, liquidity, timing, and catalyst-strength factors. It is not an investment recommendation.

scenario.name: GB200 material-cleared supplier-HBM-to-Abilene chain demonstrator
scenario.notes: Frozen draw-linked material-cleared manufacturing and site-operational results replace overlapping synthetic constraints. The material-coverage definition, site share, and remaining capacity inputs are synthetic.
scenario.scope_notes: Accelerator-package through rack-integration outputs represent the selected illustrative Blackwell supply flow after supplier HBM replaces aggregate HBM and material-cleared package starts absorb interposer and substrate availability once. A shipped-stage synthetic allocation narrows later output to the Abilene-target subset. Direct interposer and substrate capacity, supplier economics, consensus, opportunity ranking, and customer allocation remain outside this run.

warnings: Capacity, yield, allocation, economics, and consensus inputs marked synthetic are demonstration data, not market estimates.
